parameters.n_cities: <int> Number of cities the salesman must visit in the tour.
parameters.coordinate_range: <list[float], length 2> Lower and upper bounds of the square region in which city coordinates are placed.
parameters.penalty_A: <int> Penalty weight applied to violations of the requirement that exactly one city is visited at each time step in the unconstrained reformulation.
parameters.penalty_B: <int> Penalty weight applied to violations of the requirement that each city appears at exactly one time step in the unconstrained reformulation.

data.coordinates: <list[list[float]], shape [n_cities][2]> Two-dimensional position of each city within the coordinate range.
data.distance_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [n_cities][n_cities]> Euclidean distance between each pair of cities, where entry [i][j] is the travel distance from city i to city j.
